description: The account e-mail and limits. plan: "free" (limit per hour) or "custom" (limit per 24 hours). hourLimit / usedHour count conversions in the last 60 minutes, dailyLimit / usedToday in the last 24 hours (rolling windows, not calendar days); maxFileMb is the maximum file size. 0 in any limit means no limit. Every conversion the server accepts counts, also one that fails later; rejected requests and the other tools do not.
name: get_account
title: Account and limits
